title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Rio 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape’s Rio is an irresistible tropical flavour that tastes of nothing less than pure sunshine. Rich, juicy mangosteens marry perfectly with tangy guava, and finished to perfection with a streak of zesty citrus and a touch of ice for maximum refreshment. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
